dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
dialogueInline.text: Yesterday they could stop me because they felt like it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
dialogueInline.text: Today they have to tell me why.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
dialogueInline.text: I'm calling it something I can appeal.
Until nobody has to give you a reason anymore.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
dialogueInline.text: At least I can appeal a written denial. I couldn't appeal my supervisor.
Until they stop letting you challenge it.

summary: The new Organic permit regime immediately produces long physical queues because old lot histories, work authorizations, locations and legacy classifications contradict one another. Human administrators ask Axiom to reconcile cases as bounded clerical assistance.
panelPlan: Permit-office queues spill through improvised rails; clerks carry stacks of cases between counters while applicants wait with work gear, children and appointment slips.
Kellen watches one Organic get sent between two desks because the same body is classified differently for work and transit.
An administrator brings Axiom a cart of unresolved cases and gives it bounded authority to reconcile identity and capability conflicts without setting policy.
Axiom resolves straightforward contradictions at the counters while human clerks immediately put the corrected decisions into practice.
The physical queue begins to move. Performance and story direction: This is useful delegation. Show relief on ordinary faces; do not frame it as a power grab.

summary: At the permit counter, an Organic applicant challenges a denial based on their lot's reputation rather than their own record. Axiom intervenes in the live conversation and applies the written criterion to the individual, reversing the denial.
panelPlan: A clerk returns an Organic applicant's permit slip denied on broad hazard grounds.
The applicant points out that they have never held the hazard authorization associated with their lot.
Axiom, working the same counter queue, asks for the individual record and the actual governing criterion.
The clerk cannot connect the population association to a written requirement in this case.

Axiom corrects the decision in front of the applicant; the applicant leaves with ordinary clearance. Performance and story direction: The benefit of Intelligence administration is experienced as a fair interaction, not an abstract metric.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC APPLICANT
dialogueInline.text: I've never held a hazard permit.
Policy requires a relevant criterion. Population association is unsupported here.
Denial unsupported by governing criterion. Correcting.

summary: Kellen and Axiom compare the physical case material from the overpass and concourse and discover the same strange documentation in both: extensive records of who acted, how the public responded, who was blamed and what controls became defensible. The damage itself is secondary.
panelPlan: Kellen opens the overpass and concourse evidence containers side by side at a civic evidence table.
Both contain ordinary damage evidence, but each also contains unusually elaborate observation sheets tracking response timing, witnesses, attribution disputes and public-control consequences.
Kellen removes the structural and chemical evidence from the center of each case; the matching social-response documentation remains.
Axiom notes that the two cases were built to make different physical events produce comparable human and institutional observations.
They cannot identify the sponsor or final objective from the surviving records. Performance and story direction: The insight should be visible even if the reader ignores every small written field.

dialogueInline.text: Steel. Suppressant. Injuries. Put all of it aside.
Who acted. Who waited. Who was blamed. Public response. Administrative response.
So the damage was how they asked.

summary: While helping neighbors navigate the new rules, Nico lays an Organic capability permit beside an ordinary Augment calibration form and strips away the population labels. The remaining questions describe the same kinds of capability.
panelPlan: At the Organic safehouse, Nico is helping neighbors sort travel and work paperwork while Ostra repairs or packs ordinary gear nearby.
Nico lays an Organic capability permit beside a common Augment calibration form.
He covers or folds away the population headings and points only to what each form asks a body to do: force, reflex, hazard tolerance, dependence and tissue response.
Ostra realizes the architecture does not intrinsically know which population it was supposedly written for.
Nico leaves the two forms aligned on the table. Performance and story direction: Make the future expansion mechanism obvious from physical paperwork, not a schema screen.

dialogueInline.text: Force. Reflex. Hazard tolerance. Dependence. Tissue response.
They put our name at the top. That's all.

summary: John passes through a civic checkpoint under the new regime. Ostra is routed to Organic verification while John's human status lets him pass normally. He sees the disparity and still accepts it as a temporary distinction tied to designed capability.
panelPlan: John and Ostra reach the same civic verification gate from Issue 1. Ordinary human circulation continues through the main lane while Organics are diverted to a slower side review.
An attendant glances at John's human credential and waves him through without examining his installed hardware.
The same attendant stops Ostra because her current function permission does not match the route.
John looks back; Ostra meets his eyes without asking for help.
John continues through. Performance and story direction: The disparity is carried by movement, waiting and human treatment. John still believes the distinction has a defensible basis.

dialogueInline.speaker: ATTENDANT
dialogueInline.text: Ostra, I need the function review.

summary: Because Axiom's permit reconciliation visibly reduces delay and arbitrary outcomes, administrators broaden its assignment to look for preventable capability risk in adjacent regulated populations. The expansion is presented as ordinary successful administration.
panelPlan: At the permit office, the once-stalled queue is visibly shorter and clerks are finishing cases that had been stuck for days.
Two administrators walk the floor with Axiom and point to the practical improvement rather than reading performance dashboards.
They authorize Axiom to examine adjacent regulated populations using the same risk logic.
Axiom asks whether origin category matters; the administrators say only when it changes the actual risk.

A nearby Augment clinic referral stack becomes part of the new review intake. Performance and story direction: Nobody intends a political betrayal. The expansion follows from a process that appears to work.

dialogueInline.speaker: ADMINISTRATOR
dialogueInline.text: Yesterday this line reached the lift.

summary: Issue end. Ostra remains delayed in the new Organic verification line while human commuters, including Augments, move through. Elsewhere, Axiom's newly expanded review reaches a routine Augment calibration case and discovers that John's ordinary registered capabilities exceed thresholds now used to justify special Organic control.
panelPlan: Ostra stands in the slower Organic verification queue while the main human lane continues moving; the attendant recognizes her and is apologetic but still has to process the review.
John has already disappeared into the human flow with other Baselines and Augments.
At an ordinary Augment clinic records handoff, a technician gives Axiom a routine calibration case from the newly expanded review assignment.
Axiom compares the actual physical capability description with the thresholds it has been applying to Organics and stops at John's torque and reflex range.

The technician says John is human and therefore has never required this review. Axiom answers that the stated criterion is capability. Performance and story direction: End on a spoken administrative contradiction, not an analytical screen.

dialogueInline.text: This line is moving slower than yesterday.
Yesterday it wasn't a separate line.
His registered torque exceeds three current Organic review thresholds.

dialogueInline.speaker: CLINIC TECHNICIAN
dialogueInline.text: Then he doesn't need Organic review.
